density.affinity: q=sigmoid(t), generally not actual marginal mu
density.loss: -(logpi_K+sum_r centered_t_r*Z_r-logESP_K)/R; R0 contributes0 to all-query means
density.teacher: Complete supplied TRAIN membership labels only, source-zero not a verified nonlink
density.support: Exactly native unilateral residual slots, mask records before duplicate coalescing; no cap/inflation
density.normalizer: FP64 full-count logaddexp DP, no exp(t)/epsilon/clipping/truncation

count_head.context: Masked endpoint sum/product; common/residual transformed means; degrees/support sizes; mean q/mean q²/max q

capacity.basis: Source integer formulas, not instantiated-model receipt

native_clamp_source_verified.order: p0=sigmoid(scale*(score-offset)); q=pt*p0/(pt*p0+1-p0); native_weight=alpha*q; multiply residual-membership values; sum features

main_and_auxiliary.structured_weight: 1.05*B, B sampled from pi/t, parameters detached
main_and_auxiliary.main_loss: Native positive/negative log-sigmoid means over queries x four draws
main_and_auxiliary.auxiliary: Positive-query mean+negative-query mean stable full-pattern NLL/R at lambda1
main_and_auxiliary.scorer_counthead_encoder_aux_gradients: Complete native scorer and count-context path

C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.law: Product Bernoulli(actual mu from the C64-D4 bank), independent slots
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.bank: Same C64-D4-selected checkpoint; no refit/own selection
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.uniforms: Same keyed slot uniforms and draw indices; joint route additionally uses count uniform
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.count_law: Poisson-binomial(mu), replaces pi without changing marginals
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.scope: Prediction-route retention of dependence at fixed learned bank; does not isolate auxiliary training effects
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.finite_draw_noise: Disclosed, not an exact expected-score comparison
C64_M4_fixed_bank_control.evaluation: Once at selected checkpoint on complete VALID and fixed diagnostic set

randomness.count_init: Separate CPU generator; SHA256 domain ncnc-cardinality-single-v1|seed=0|domain=count-init, first8 bytes little-endian modulo2^31-1; Xavier matrices/zero biases
randomness.completion_uniforms: Separate counter stream; (integer53+.5)/2^53, fixed four draws
randomness.training_query_ordinal: Combined positive then negative query list, not a label input
randomness.eval_key: Arm version, seed, canonical unordered endpoints, draw, count/slot purpose, canonical counterpart identity; no label/pool/epoch/batch keys
randomness.native_sampling: Pinned native seed0 laws/counts/drop-last; different scorer/dropout work can change later global-RNG permutations

selection.rule: First strict best complete VALID; exact ties first

resources.DP: O(R²) per query, paid FP64 forward/recompute/backward
resources.score: One complete native scorer plus auxiliary backward
resources.decode: Four draws each selected route; M4 adds four paid decodes
resources.failure: Close specified arm, no smaller supports/batches/evaluation, changed precision or extra fit

limits: Model comparison changes serving versus J/F
C64-M4 isolates retained dependence at fixed bank only
No graph occurrence/calibration/mode superiority/global novelty claim
